content: Monkeytype (open-source, monkeytypegame/monkeytype, frontend/src/ts/test/test-stats.ts calculateWpmAndRaw(), per DeepWiki summary of the source): WPM = (correctWordChars + correctSpaces) * 60 / testSeconds / 5; Raw WPM = (allCorrectChars + spaces + incorrectChars + extraChars) * 60 / testSeconds / 5. Raw WPM counts every typed character (right or wrong) as productive; net/WPM counts only correct chars+spaces. Division by 5 is the standard 'word = 5 chars' normalization. testSeconds is Monkeytype's own wall-clock test duration (Monkeytype has no active-time exclusion; keebdrill's D-01 substitutes computeActiveElapsedMs instead, an intentional divergence).
